title: Deficiency report for one plan (one test case)
description: What any system under test (agent, chatbot baseline, ablation) must write for each case, as <runs_dir>/<case_id>.json. The scorer reads only these fields.

system.description: Name of the system that produced the report, e.g. full-agent, chatbot-baseline.

checklist_id.description: Checklist item id from knowledge/checklist.yaml, or "other" if none fits.

file.description: Document the flag points to, e.g. body.md. Give a section or pages too: a flag needs a place to get credit. For missing content, give the section where it belongs. Null only if a whole document is missing.

pages.description: PDF page numbers from the page markers.

quote.description: Exact text from the plan supporting the flag, if any.

explanation.description: What is wrong and why it matters.
